title: Indoor Place of Assembly Safety Personnel
page_numbering: PDF page index (1 = first page of the PDF file)

questions.question: The FDNY may require at least one place of assembly safety personnel where the Certificate of Occupancy indicates how many people will gather INDOORS?
questions.explanation: Safety personnel may be required where 75 or more people gather indoors (200 or more outdoors).

source.quote: the Certificate of Occupancy indicates that 75 or more people will gather indoors or 200 or more outdoors.

questions.question: The FDNY may require at least one place of assembly safety personnel where the Certificate of Occupancy indicates how many people will gather OUTDOORS?
questions.explanation: The outdoor threshold is 200 or more people (indoor is 75 or more).

source.quote: the Certificate of Occupancy indicates that 75 or more people will gather indoors or 200 or more outdoors.

questions.question: For a temporary place of assembly (TPA) event, when must safety personnel arrive and how long must they stay?
options: When the doors open, until the headliner finishes
15 minutes before the event, until the event ends
At least 1 hour before the event, and until all audience members leave
At least 4 hours before, until midnight
questions.explanation: TPA safety personnel arrive at least 1 hour prior and remain until all audience members leave.

source.quote: the safety personnel are required to arrive at the premises at least 1 hour prior to the events and remain until all audience members leave.

questions.question: For a temporary place of assembly event, where is the minimum number of safety personnel indicated?
options: On the Certificate of Fitness card
questions.explanation: For TPA situations, the minimum number of safety personnel will be indicated on the TPA permit.

source.quote: For the temporary place of assembly situations, the minimum number of safety personnel will be indicated on the TPA permit.

questions.question: According to the study material, how are most occupants of places of assembly likely to exit?
options: The same way they entered, even if it is not the nearest or safest exit
Through the exit closest to the stage
questions.explanation: Most occupants exit the way they came in; safety personnel help direct them to the nearest and safest exit.

source.quote: likely to exit the same way they entered the building, whether or not it is the nearest or safest exit.

questions.question: What is the main duty of place of assembly safety personnel in a fire or other emergency?
options: To fight the fire with hose lines
To reset the fire alarm panel
questions.explanation: Their main duties are to assist the occupants in the event of a fire or other emergency.

source.quote: Their main duties are to “assist the occupants” in the event of a fire or other emergency.

questions.question: Which assembly occupancy group includes restaurants, bars and nightclubs?
questions.explanation: Group A-2 covers assembly uses intended for food and/or drink consumption, such as restaurants, taverns, bars and nightclubs.

source.quote: Assembly Group A-2 includes assembly uses intended for food and/or drink consumption.

questions.question: Which assembly occupancy group includes motion picture theaters and concert halls, usually with fixed seating?
questions.explanation: Group A-1 is for the production and viewing of performing arts or motion pictures, usually with fixed seating.

source.quote: Assembly Group A-1 occupancy includes assembly uses usually with fixed seating, intended for the production and viewing of performing arts or motion pictures.

questions.question: Which assembly occupancy group includes amusement parks, bleachers, grandstands and stadiums?
questions.explanation: Group A-5 covers participation in or viewing of outdoor activities.

source.quote: Assembly Group A-5 includes assembly uses intended for participation in or viewing outdoor activities.

questions.question: What is an "assembly area" as defined in the study material?
options: A designated area outside a building to which occupants report during an evacuation
A storage room for folding chairs
The lobby where tickets are sold
The main seating area of a theater
questions.explanation: An assembly area is a designated area outside of a building where occupants report upon evacuation.

source.quote: A designated area outside of a building to which building occupants are directed to report upon implementation of a partial or full evacuation

questions.question: What is a "partial evacuation"?
options: Evacuating everyone except the safety personnel
The emptying of a building of some but not all occupants
questions.explanation: Partial evacuation is the emptying of some but not all building occupants in response to a fire or emergency.

source.quote: Partial Evacuation - The emptying of a building of some but not all building occupants in response to a fire or an emergency.

questions.question: Which are the two duties of place of assembly safety personnel named in the study material?
options: Maintaining occupant safety during a gathering, and assisting in implementing the evacuation plan
questions.explanation: The two duties are maintaining the safety of occupants and assisting in implementing the evacuation plan.

source.quote: Two duties of the place of assembly safety personnel are: (1) maintaining the safety of the occupants during a gathering; and (2) assisting

questions.question: If defects are found during the pre-event visual check, when should arrangements be made to correct them?
questions.explanation: The owner or designated responsible person should arrange to have defects corrected IMMEDIATELY.

source.quote: should make arrangements to have the defects corrected IMMEDIATELY.

questions.question: If a required fire protection system is out of service at a place of assembly, what is required?
options: Only a sign on the door
Nothing, if the event is short
questions.explanation: If any required fire protection system is out of service, additional F-01 fire guard(s) are required.

source.quote: If any required fire protection system is out of service, additional F-01 fire guard(s) is/are required.

questions.question: In the ESCAPE pre-event inspection acronym, what does "C" stand for?
questions.explanation: C is Capacity: the number of people does not exceed the posted capacity and capacity certificates are posted.

source.quote: C - Capacity – The number of persons occupying the building or space does not exceed the posted capacity.

questions.question: In the ESCAPE pre-event inspection acronym, what does "P" stand for?
options: Protection (smoke, fire alarm, sprinkler systems and extinguishers in working order)
questions.explanation: P is Protection: smoke, fire alarm and sprinkler systems and fire extinguishers are in proper working order.

source.quote: P - Protection – Smoke, fire alarm, sprinkler systems, and fire extinguishers are in proper working order.

questions.question: What does the first "E" in the ESCAPE acronym check?
options: Exits are unblocked, unlocked, and properly marked
questions.explanation: E is Exits: all exits are unblocked, unlocked, and properly marked.

source.quote: E - Exits – All exits are unblocked, unlocked, and properly marked

questions.question: During an event you notice your area is excessively crowded. What should you do?
options: Lock the exit doors to stop more people entering
Inform your supervisor immediately and follow their instructions
Ignore it until the event ends
questions.explanation: If your responsible area is excessively crowded, inform your supervisor immediately and follow his/her instruction.

source.quote: If you notice that your responsible area is excessively crowded, you should inform your supervisor immediately and follow his/her instruction.

questions.question: Are people allowed to stand in a required aisle during an event?
questions.explanation: Required aisles must be unobstructed; people are NOT allowed to stand in an aisle.

source.quote: Required aisles must be unobstructed. People are NOT allowed to stand, in an aisle.

questions.question: In a performing arts or motion picture theater, when must the Certificate of Fitness holder conduct daily visual checks?
options: Only when the FDNY is present
On any day the premises is to be used and occupied for a performance
questions.explanation: Daily visual checks are required on any day the theater is used and occupied for a performance.

source.quote: must conduct the daily visual checks in a performing arts or motion picture theater on any day in which the premises is to be used

questions.question: In a theater, how should standpipe and sprinkler system monthly inspection records be kept?
options: They do not need to be kept
On loose sheets in the manager's car
Up to date, in a bound logbook, readily available to the FDNY
questions.explanation: Monthly inspection records should be up to date, in a bound logbook and readily available for FDNY inspection.

source.quote: Standpipe and sprinkler systems monthly inspection records should be up to date and in a bound logbook

questions.question: How long must theater logbooks and records be kept on the premises?
options: Until the end of the current show's run
questions.explanation: All logbooks and records must be kept on the premises for a minimum of three years.

source.quote: All logbooks and records must be kept on the premises for a minimum of three (3) years

questions.question: How soon before the start of each performance should the exit location announcement be made?
questions.explanation: The audio announcement about exits should be made not more than 10 minutes before the start of each performance.

source.quote: The event coordinator should make an audio announcement not more than 10 minutes prior to the start of each performance or program.

questions.question: How high must the rope, tape or barrier separating a standing area in a theater be?
options: Not less than 3 feet and not more than 4 feet above the floor
Not less than 1 foot and not more than 2 feet
questions.explanation: Standing areas are separated by barriers not less than 3 feet and not more than 4 feet above the floor.

source.quote: A height of not less than 3 feet and not more than 4 feet above the floor

questions.question: How many rows of persons are allowed to stand in theater balconies?
questions.explanation: For balconies, only one row of persons is allowed to stand.

source.quote: For balconies, only one row of persons is allowed to stand in balconies.

questions.question: You hold both an F-03 and an F-01 Certificate of Fitness. A sprinkler system is out of service during a performance. Can you perform both duties at the same time?
options: Yes, F-03 duties include F-01 duties
Yes, if the theater is small
questions.explanation: The F-03 does not cover F-01 duties, and an F-01 holder cannot do both duties at the same time.

source.quote: If you hold an F-01 Certificate of Fitness, you CANNOT do both duties at the same time.

questions.question: Before a temporary place of assembly event, what must the sponsor and any promoter provide?
options: A parking plan approved by the police
A site plan approved by the NYC Department of Buildings
questions.explanation: The sponsor and promoter must provide a site plan approved by the NYC Department of Buildings.

source.quote: the sponsor and any promoter of the event must provide a site plan approved by the NYC Department of Buildings.

questions.question: At a TPA event, what must every safety personnel posted at an exit normally be equipped with?
questions.explanation: Personnel at an exit must have two-way radio communication to reach persons manning a telephone to the Fire Department.

source.quote: every safety personnel posted at an exit must be equipped with a two-way radio communication (walkie-talkie)

questions.question: At a TPA event, what must safety personnel posted at an event entrance normally be equipped with?
options: A device to verify the occupancy count, such as a scanner or hand-held counter
questions.explanation: Personnel at an entrance need a device (scanner, hand-held counter, ticket) to verify the occupancy count.

source.quote: every safety personnel posted at an event entrance must be equipped with a device (e.g., scanner, hand-held counter, ticket) to verify the occupancy count.

questions.question: At an outdoor public gathering, what is prohibited regarding portable CNG cylinders?
questions.explanation: The storage, handling and use of portable CNG cylinders are prohibited at outdoor public gatherings.

source.quote: The storage, handling and use of portable CNG cylinders are prohibited at outdoor public gatherings.

questions.question: At an outdoor public gathering, when must fueling of generators be done?
options: Before the event is open to the public
After the first hour of the event
questions.explanation: All fueling of generators and other approved devices must be done before the event opens to the public.

source.quote: all fueling of generators and other approved devices, equipment and systems must be conducted before the event is open to the public.

questions.question: May guests charge or store lithium-ion batteries (e-bikes, scooters) at TPA events?
options: Yes, if the battery is under 50% charge
Yes, if supervised by a guest
questions.explanation: Guests are NOT permitted to charge or store lithium-ion batteries at events.

source.quote: Guests are NOT permitted to charge or store lithium-ion batteries at events.

questions.question: What is required to use pyrotechnics at an event?
options: Nothing, if the event is outdoors
questions.explanation: Pyrotechnic use is strictly prohibited without a permit from the FDNY.

source.quote: Pyrotechnic use is strictly prohibited without a permit from the FDNY.

questions.question: Why should electric wires at an event be secured by cord covers?
questions.explanation: Wires should be secured by cord covers to minimize tripping hazards.

source.quote: The electric wires should be secured by cord covers in order to minimize the tripping hazards.

questions.question: What hazard do temporary, unsecured or un-ganged chairs pose?
options: A great hazard in an emergency
No hazard if they are new
questions.explanation: Chairs should be ganged; unsecured or un-ganged chairs may pose a great hazard in an emergency.

source.quote: Temporary, unsecured or un-ganged chairs may pose a great hazard in event of emergency.

questions.question: What is the most effective way to notify the building occupants in case of a fire emergency?
options: Activating the fire alarm pull station
questions.explanation: Activating the pull station is the most effective way to notify the building occupants of a fire.

source.quote: Activating the pull station is the most effective way to notify the building occupants in case of a fire emergency.

questions.question: After a pull station has been activated, when can the fire alarm control panel be reset?
options: Only at the pull station itself
Only when directed by a Fire Department representative, by an S-95 holder
By any staff member once the alarm stops
questions.explanation: The alarm must be reset at the main FACP after the pull station is reset, and only when directed by a Fire Department representative, by an S-95 holder.

source.quote: Only when directed by a Fire Department representative, an S-95 holder, the alarm control panel can then be re-set.

questions.question: What equipment does the FDNY highly recommend place of assembly safety personnel carry?
options: A fire axe and a hose
A ladder and a hard hat
A megaphone and a whistle only
A flashlight, a two-way radio and a cell phone
questions.explanation: The FDNY highly recommends a flashlight, a two-way radio communication device and a cell phone.

source.quote: the FDNY highly recommends that you should be equipped with a flashlight, two-way radio communication device (e.g., walkie talkie), and a cell phone.

questions.question: You reach your post and have no cellular service. What should you do?
options: Do nothing until an emergency happens
Leave your post to find a signal
Immediately notify your supervisor and plan another form of communication
questions.explanation: If you have no cellular service, immediately notify your supervisor and plan another form of communication.

source.quote: If you reach your post and have no cellular service, you should immediately notify your supervisor.

questions.question: In a fire emergency with no fire safety director or FEP staff in charge, where should you evacuate occupants to?
options: Along evacuation routes to the assembly areas designated by the evacuation plan
questions.explanation: Without an FSD or FEP staff, evacuate along evacuation routes to assembly areas designated by the plan.

source.quote: evacuate the area (in-building relocation, partial evacuation, or evacuation of building occupants) along evacuation routes to assembly areas designated by the evacuation plan.

questions.question: For place of assembly events with attendance over what number may an on-site emergency health care facility be provided?
questions.explanation: For events with attendance over 5,000, an on-site emergency health care facility may be provided.

source.quote: For the place of assembly events with an attendance of over 5,000 people, an on-site emergency health care facility may be provided.

questions.question: During a medical emergency, when should the victim be moved?
options: As soon as the victim can stand
Only if the victim's location is unsafe
questions.explanation: Do not move the victim unless the victim's location is unsafe.

source.quote: Do not move the victim unless the victim’s location is unsafe.

questions.question: You find a suspicious package and cannot verify its contents. What should you do with it?
options: Do not touch, move or open it
questions.explanation: For a suspicious package, do not touch, move or open the article and follow emergency reporting protocols.

source.quote: Do not touch/move/open the article.

questions.question: Should the manual fire alarm be activated during an active shooter emergency?
options: Yes, but only on the ground floor
No; pull stations should only be activated during fire or smoke conditions
questions.explanation: The manual fire alarm should NOT be activated for an active shooter emergency.

source.quote: Manual Fire Alarm System should NOT be activated for an active shooter emergency.

questions.question: If an active shooter incident is occurring OUTSIDE the building, what should safety personnel do with building occupants?
options: Prevent them from evacuating, to avoid the outside threat
Evacuate everyone out the front door
Send them to the parking lot
questions.explanation: Secure entrances, relocate occupants to safe areas, and prevent occupants from evacuating into the outside threat.

source.quote: prevent building occupants from evacuating to avoid encountering the outside threat.

questions.question: What are the three survival tactics suggested by the NYPD for an active shooter incident inside a building?
questions.explanation: The three tactics are Avoid (run/evacuate), Barricade (hide), Confront (fight/take action).

source.quote: following one of the three tactics: Avoid, Barricade, Confront.

questions.question: Class K fires involve which materials?
options: Ordinary combustibles like wood and paper
Vegetable oils, animal oils or fats in cooking appliances
questions.explanation: Class K fires involve vegetable oils, animal oils, or fats in cooking appliances, as in commercial kitchens.

source.quote: Class K fires are fires that involve vegetable oils, animal oils, or fats in cooking appliances.

questions.question: How can you identify an FDNY outdoor portable fire extinguisher tag?
options: The series number on the back contains a "D" letter
questions.explanation: Outdoor tags are durable and tear resistant; the series number on the back contains a "D" and/or an "O" is printed on the front.

source.quote: On the back of the tag, the series number will contain a “D” letter;

questions.question: What lesson does the study material draw from the Station Nightclub fire (West Warwick, RI, 2003)?
options: The band had a valid pyrotechnics permit
The club did not have an automatic fire sprinkler system
The club had too many exits
The fire was caused by a kitchen grease fire
questions.explanation: Lessons learned include that the club did not have an automatic fire sprinkler system to extinguish the fire.

source.quote: The club did not have an automatic fire sprinkler system to extinguish the fire.
